translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Nebugadenesa ibugua wai bule manda bu henego ogo

Asiria dindiha Nebugadenesa ibu kini henego mali nguirani tebira (18) hayagola mali ogoninaga ege mbira horo pira kirani kira (22) layagola bi dibudibu mbira kini andagaha howa lo yu tagira ibiyagome lalu, Ibunaga bi mbira buleore lowa lowialu dindi maruha bi mo wahalu ibu biamogo bule naibiyaru pani mialu bo wahai holebero, lo wini.

Ani lalu kini ibugua ami agali haguane bu hearubi haru bamba haga hearubi agali haguane maru hearubi bibahende olalu, Bi lo manda bimi̱ya ibalimu, lene. Ani lowa íbu ngoai heagola ibugua dindi maruha ibunaga bi lo yalu pudaba laga biyaru mo wahayagohondo pani nelo mulenaga miniha yadoho henego latagi hene.
Tigua bi lo mbira halu lalu, Agali ibunaga bi hale nahayaru ti bibahende homelai holene nga, lalu lo mbira hene.
Bi lo mbira hai howa agali haguane mbira ami agali bibahende handaya ho howa haru haga mini Holoberenese ibuni kini biamogo biaga hapara hene heago olene. Ani lowa kini ibugua lalu,

I̱ dindi bibahendeha kini maru karu bolangua haihe kini timbuniore kogo i̱na larogo. I̱na áyu ogoni puwa agali wai bayale biaga mandabi karu hondo pu. Ami agali damene karu daosini dege handari mbirani pira kira (120,000) haru halu ami agali nogo hosini biruwa wai biagane daosini homberia (12,000) haru halu ibabe.
Ai wali agali amu ni paliragoha haga hearu tigua i̱na bi larugo mo wahayago ainde tígua dindi uruni bibahendeha piaiore halimu.

Puwa tigua i̱ni andaneha holeore lalu manane dindi ogoniha howa iba mbira hambu wia halu dindi himu mbira dugu wia hadaba labe. Ani larogoni irane i̱naga miniha ti baba tandaga timbuni ho kogo ti bo wahai hole pole berogodane laro. Ani bialu i̱naga ami agali karume tinaga dindi bibahende hengeda hai halu mbirale mbira dindi uruniha nawilo hilo wahai holeberogodane laro.
Wali agali bo waharagola tingini dindi ulini ngagoha wu to̱lalu iba emene pedarubi timbuni pedarubi bibahendeore homa tinginime payadai biaiore holebira.
Ani bialu wali agali maru bo wanahe heagua nde i̱na uruni minalu dindi kaundiaore dindi wiamaro ngagoha garabaya hole pelolebero, lene.
Holoberenese-o í̠na dindi uruni bibahende karulai hole pu. Ai tigua tini í̠naga giha ya hayagua nde i̱ni eberongi i̱na ti pani muliya helo wahabe.
Anigo tigua í̠ baba wai biyagua í̠na ti dara holene nawiore. Bo hilo wahai halu tinaga dabudabu ngaru mo yai habe.
I̱naga bi ogoni hangu. I̱ kini timbuni daligaore kogo i̱ninaga dindi timbuni ngagonaga hongome bulenego larogo. I̱na bule lalu bi lo wirugo buleorebero.
Ai Holoberenese-o í̠na bi ogo baya hangu hale habe. I̱na bi o larogo mbira wa nahabe. Bi langirugo damene talialu áyu ogoniore bule pu, lene.
Holoberenese ibugua wai bule penego ogo

Kini ibugua bi ogoni laya handala abale tagira puwa Holoberenese ibugua ami agali wai hanalu mo ta haga hearubi ami agali mini lene hearubi ami agali mini lene hearubi ami agali haru bamba haga hearubi bibahendeore Asiria ami henego. Ibai hadaba, lene.

Ibugua kinihanda bibe lalu lamiyadagua mo tale bigi bialu ami agali damene hearu daosini dege handari mbirani pira kira (120,000) dindi dindi pelo dabo helalu ami agali daosini homberia (12,000) nogo hosini biruwa danda yuwa wai biaga dabo helene.
Ibugua wai bulenedagua manda manda bu helai hene.
Ani buwa tomo noleneru dabudaburu dewaore nogo kameleru dongirunaga erekunini mo paga ho yalu nogo balu nolene sibi bulumaga memeru dewaore haru halu pene.
Ibugua ami agali ti burupale holobadago damene bibahendeore karulape mo yai halu kininaga muni wiagoha howa siliba ngolobi dewaore mo yini.

Anidagua bialu kini ibu mani ibilo Holoberenese halu ami agali biaru ti ala bamba halu pene. Garo nogo hosime gililagaru nogo hosini agali biralu ami agali geni pialu bibahendeore heyalu dindi amu ni paliragohayagi bibahendeore ti ho karula piai hole pene.
Wali agali dewaore ami agali biaru haruru talima mani pene. Ani piyagola dagalabe naheore niminamu lalu be abalu tau laradagua bini.

Ami agali uruni Niniba tano yuwahalu puwa horo tebira pialu dindi tigabi mini Begedilede dindini tagira pialu tigua balai anda Begedilede tano kawareni bini. Tano ogoni Silisia Daliga laga ngagonaga abene uyurahayagi hari bareni tano Begedilede ogoni wini.
Ani bialu Holoberenese ibugua dindi ogoni wahalu ibunaga ami agaliru haru halu hari bare bare wiagoha tagira pene.

Ani puwa tigua dindi kira mini Pudu Ludula bo gialahole bu wahai hene. Tigua ani bialu puwa wali agali Lasisi tanoha hearunaga dabudabu wiaru balu gingilo mialu Isimale wali agali hearunagabi gingilo mia dege bini. Isimale wali agali ti dindi ko iba dalu naibaga Kelusi dindi abene unurahayagi kaware haga hene.

Holoberenese halu ibunaga ami agali biaru iba Yuberedisi piyadagua pupe halu puwa dindi hobane mbira Mesobodemia tano hongohe iba Abarono ange ange wima pearu bo gialo wahai hama pialu iba solowara timbuni bereagoria tagira pene.

Tigua Silisia dindi karu lai halu agali maru Holoberenesela wai bulene manda biyaru homelo bo wahaga bini. Ani bima pialu tigua dindi abene unurahayagi Yabede Arebiala dindi tubari wiagoria tagira pene.
Tigua Midiana dindi agali nogo hinalu hearu bo talu pelalu tinaga nogo sibi ti page haru halu balai anda hearu heda haga bima pene.

Ai widi boga bini gandu lolene tu hayagola tigua Damasagasa dindiha dindi bayale tigabi wiagoha pupe halu pene. Ani puwa tigua widi mabuha bo hedope haga bialu nogo sibi meme bulumagabi bibahende bai haga bima pene. Ani bialu tigua tano bibahende bo gialo wahai halu mabu dugua hai halu igini daliahe hearu bibahende ayu tibume homelo dibu wahai halu bini.

Wali agali iba solowara bedago angeha paluyu pearu ti gi timbuniore ho howa duru laga laga bialu hene. Wali agali bibahende Taia tanoha hearubi Saidono tanoha hearubi Su tanoha hearubi Ogina tanoha hearubi Yabane tanoha hearubi Asadodo tanoha hearubi Asagelono tanoha hearubi bibahendeoreme gi ho hai hene.
